title: Oral Sedation / Chill Protocol
desc: Pre-visit sedation for dogs — the gabapentin + melatonin + acepromazine Chill Protocol, the Ace/Telazol meatball for severe cases, phenobarb + gabapentin, and trazodone with its weight chart. Clinician reference.

meds.grp: Chill Protocol — night before the appointment
meds.name: Gabapentin
meds.gen: caps 100 / 300 / 400 mg; tabs 600 / 800 mg; solution 50 mg/ml
meds.note: 20–25 mg/kg. Round to the nearest capsule — exact milligrams matter less than getting a generous dose in the night before.

meds.name: Melatonin
meds.desc: dosed by rough size band, not mg/kg
meds.doseText: 0.5 to 1 mg for a small dog, 1 to 3 mg for a medium dog, 5 mg for a large dog

meds.name: Acepromazine
meds.note: 0.025–0.05 mg/kg. Using the 10 mg/ml solution, divide the milligrams above by 10 to get the volume in ml. Given TRANSMUCOSALLY into the cheek pouch, not swallowed.

meds.name: Acepromazine in a meatball
meds.desc: injected into a meatball and offered
meds.note: 2.2 mg/kg of the 10 mg/ml solution injected into a meatball — divide the milligrams by 10 for ml. Give with the Telazol below. May instead be mixed into a SMALL volume of ice cream so it coats the tongue and lips for transmucosal absorption; consider the lower end of the dose range if given that way.

meds.name: Telazol in a meatball
meds.note: 10–20 mg/kg of the 100 mg/ml solution — divide the milligrams above by 100 for ml. Injected into a meatball alongside the acepromazine, or mixed into a small volume of ice cream for transmucosal absorption.

meds.name: Oral phenobarbital
meds.note: Oral phenobarb 10 mg/kg combined with gabapentin 10–40 mg/kg.

meds.name: Gabapentin
meds.note: 10–40 mg/kg. The wide range is deliberate — start at the low end in an older or compromised dog.

meds.name: Trazodone
meds.desc: dosed as a total amount per dog, not per kg
meds.chartNote: Trazodone is dosed as a TOTAL dose per dog, not mg/kg. As a cross-check the sheet also gives 5–10 mg/kg.
meds.note: Cross-check against 5–10 mg/kg. Run the initiation dose for about 3 days before the appointment where there is time.

notes.Chill Protocol timing: Gabapentin 20–25 mg/kg the NIGHT BEFORE; gabapentin 20–25 mg/kg again plus melatonin 2 HOURS BEFORE; acepromazine 0.025–0.05 mg/kg transmucosally 30 MINUTES BEFORE. The night-before dose is the one most often skipped, and the one that makes the difference.
notes.Gabapentin formulations: Capsules 100, 300 and 400 mg; tablets 600 and 800 mg; oral solution 50 mg/ml. Avoid xylitol-containing liquid preparations.
notes.For very difficult dogs: A meatball injected with acepromazine 2.2 mg/kg and Telazol 10–20 mg/kg. Alternatively mixed with ice cream — ideally a small volume so it coats the tongue and lips for transmucosal absorption, though a lower dose may be appropriate given that route.
notes.Acepromazine transmucosal: The 10 mg/ml injectable is placed in the cheek pouch rather than swallowed. Divide milligrams by 10 for the volume in ml.
notes.Trazodone dosing: The chart is a total dose per dog, not mg/kg. Cross-check against 5–10 mg/kg.
